Weapons can be equipped at the Armory or in a Hellpod on the Bridge before missions in Helldivers 2.

Overview

Weapons have different damage types. Most have recoil.

Acquisition

Most personal weapons are unlocked through Warbonds using Medals, with some exceptions.[1]

Most support weapons are purchased through the Ship Management with Requisition Slips, with some exceptions.[2]

Support Weapons

Support weapons are selected as part of your loadout during deployment. Once on the battlefield, Helldivers can summon these weapons by inputting a unique stratagem code and throwing a beacon on the ground. They are then delivered from the Destroyer to the planet's surface via Hellpods. Certain supports are either exclusive to or also available at various POIs.
